title: Extract a broken tap from a robot travel-axis carriage
instruction: Clear the damaged mounting hole so this robot carriage can be assembled.
setup: Development gate: full-scale AR4 carriage, three-flute M8x1.25 tap fragment, matching Walton10313 extractor, small machine vise.
